what: One still per picked hero, its final reveal step, 1920x1080. Ordered strongest first. Built from ledger keys (sf-figures.js, generated by gen-figures.js from 02-research\ledger.json, values and units verbatim); not the built boards. H11.note: Two parts that share nothing, not even a scale. 2026, full year: revenue as the analysts' average ($254.1B, dashed, labelled analyst estimate, S&P Global, 8 Oct; Meta gives no full-year revenue guide) beside Meta's capex guide ($130B to $145B, hatched, Meta guidance, 29 Jul). Expenses are left off: beside capex they invite a double count. Q2 2026, on its own scale: revenue $60.80B, operating cash flow $31.86B, capex $31.08B taken out of it, and $784M of free cash flow left. Live, the full year draws first, then the rule, then the quarter steps down column by column on each figure the voice says.
H11.live: Built live as the motion test (8 Oct): dashboards	-the-bill.html. Steps on the v11 words at 150 wpm: open 0.4 s, capex guidance 5.2 s ('$130'), analyst estimate 7.2 s, Q2 2026 9.2 s, revenue 10.4 s ('$60.8'), operating cash flow 12.8 s ('costs': a copy of revenue slides across and its top is cut away), capex 14.8 s (a copy of operating cash flow slides across and all but the sliver goes), $784M 18.0 s, then it holds still to 31.2 s. Its figures need the rows in assets\data-rows\data-rows.js merged into shared\data.js (Davinci).
